global_style: A minimalist, nature-inspired presentation template utilizing a desaturated 'Morandi' green color palette, floating cards, and elegant typography.

identity_anchors: Large, central floating white cards with heavily rounded corners
Desaturated, low-contrast sage green background elements
Soft, uniform drop shadows to create a layered 'paper' effect
Minimalist typography mixing elegant serifs for headers and clean sans-serifs for body text

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
